technical_analysis: Our Axiom Cortex™ vetting presents candidates with a React app suffering from high INP (>500ms) due to excessive re-renders. A successful candidate must use the React Profiler to diagnose the cause—typically improper state management or missing memoization. The required fix involves refactoring state to use Suspense-friendly data patterns and applying `React.memo` or `useCallback` strategically. We require our nearshore React developers to not only fix the issue but also to articulate a testing strategy to prevent regressions. The goal is a stable INP score below 200ms under simulated load. This process ensures the nearshore React developers we provide can build applications that are both robust and performant, meeting enterprise quality standards.
